# Talkin.icu

> > A developer-focused blog covering troubleshooting guides, backend development, and open source tools across Python, JavaScript, and various frameworks.

Talkin.icu provides practical technical guides and troubleshooting solutions for modern software development challenges. The site covers topics ranging from NestJS and Python dependency management to API security, database persistence, and build error resolution, with a focus on real-world developer problems and their solutions.

## Key Topics

- Troubleshooting & Debugging
- Python (uv, astral-sh, pytest)
- Backend Development (NestJS, TypeORM, PostgreSQL)
- API Security & Best Practices
- Data Persistence & State Management
- Package Management (npm, yarn)
- GitHub & Open Source
- Windows & WSL Development
- React Native & Expo
- Elasticsearch
- Machine Learning (TensorFlow, PyTorch)
- Feature Requests & UX
- Build Errors & Configuration
- Developer Tooling

## Backend Development & Architecture

- [NestJS Project Setup: PostgreSQL, TypeORM & More](https://talkin.icu/blog/nestjs-project-setup-postgresql-typeorm): NestJS backend setup with PostgreSQL and TypeORM integration guide
- [Keep Your Count: Persisting Data After Service Restarts](https://talkin.icu/blog/keep-your-count-persisting-data): Backend data persistence and state management after service restarts
- [Securing Your API Key: Best Practices To Avoid Exposure](https://talkin.icu/blog/securing-your-api-key-best): API key security with dotenv and GitHub best practices guide
